events.description: Introduction of Euler's formula F = E - V + 1 and substitution of V = n + nC4
events.clip_query: Euler's formula F = E - V + 1 is shown, and V is substituted with n + nC4

events.description: Substitution of E = nC2 + 2*nC4 + n into the formula
events.clip_query: E is substituted with nC2 + 2*nC4 + n in the formula

events.description: Highlighting and cancellation of matching terms
events.clip_query: Terms in the equation flash and fade out to show algebraic cancellation

events.description: Rearrangement of remaining terms into the final simplified formula using curved paths
events.clip_query: The remaining terms smoothly slide along curved paths to form F = 1 + nC2 + nC4
